category_title: Elementary student with Duchenne muscular dystrophy exhibiting task-avoidant and attention-seeking disruptive behaviors
minimal_context: Philip is in his classroom during a language lesson and is asked to complete a written exercise.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Class, it is time for our language lesson. Please look at the board and write the language exercise in your notebooks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves his seat without permission and wanders over to another student's desk) I'm not doing that.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Philip, you need to go back to your place and do your work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Interrupts the lesson speaking out of turn and annoys his classmates) No! I don't have to listen to you!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Walks over and tries to drive him to his seat) Come on, let's go back to your seat and sit down.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Falls on the ground, cries, and refuses to stand up. Grabs a nearby object and tries to throw it, insulting the teacher) Get away from me, you idiot! I hate this!

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Philip’s teacher asks from the students to write a language exercise

challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: avoid what seems to him a task which is difficult to complete

behavior_patterns.condition: teacher’s attempt to seat him again
